Answers about lounge space at the skyport
The desk wrote this for first-time travelers
Lounge Space for Traveling Pets

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers prepare pets for a safe and orderly journey through Aurelia Skyways. This article explains how lounge space is handled before departure and what a traveler should bring to the desk.

Lounge access is arranged for comfort, supervision, and smooth boarding. When a passenger arrives with a pet, staff review the booking, confirm the travel plan, and note service changes in the desk ledger. If a traveler is concerned, the supervisor listens carefully and gives calm guidance before the pet moves onward.

For some animals, the desk may require supporting documents before any lounge placement is approved. <<FACT F079>> Travelers should carry the original paperwork and keep it ready for inspection. If the documents are incomplete, staff may ask for clarification before the pet is accepted.

The size and condition of the carrier also matter. A secure crate should allow the animal to rest safely, remain clean, and stay under control during handling. <<FACT F066>> Staff will check the carrier carefully and may request a different arrangement if the setup is not suitable.

Some pets need extra review because of age, species, or transport method. <<FACT F075>> The desk will explain the next steps in clear language and will not proceed until the record is in order.

Travelers should arrive with the pet calm, supervised, and ready for inspection. Keep food, water, and comfort items organized as instructed, and follow any direction given by the team.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
